completion_evidence.acceptance_criterion: Receipt binds the source revision, derived Hub revision, release root, Security IR root, current tree, evaluation summary, and passing end-to-end gates; no candidate result is represented as authority.

CVESIR-G000.title: Pinned CVE security reasoning and enforcement loop

completion_evidence.acceptance_criterion: Pin and shard hashes are verified; rows are bounded and inert; serialized descriptions are parsed without eval; malformed and drifted inputs fail closed; tokens never enter artifacts.

CVESIR-G010.title: Pinned CVEfixes source snapshot and safe row adapter

completion_evidence.acceptance_criterion: Canonical round-trip and CID stability pass; parent/source/config identities are mandatory; NaN, unknown fields, duplicate IDs, and authority broadening fail closed.

CVESIR-G020.title: Canonical derived dataset schemas and identities

completion_evidence.acceptance_criterion: Default public profile excludes unrestricted full bodies; provenance is retained; source instructions remain inert; detected secrets, unsafe paths, unreviewed licenses, and policy drift block release.

CVESIR-G030.title: Licensing, privacy, poisoning, and release policy

completion_evidence.acceptance_criterion: Pairing and provenance are loss-aware; deterministic facts are distinct from model candidates; fixed code is negative evidence; unsupported languages and ambiguous hunks are retained rather than fabricated or dropped.
Node and edge types/directions validate; all edges bind sources and endpoints; similarity edges are marked non-authoritative; graph rebuild is deterministic and detects tampering.
Queries cap shards/nodes/results; filters cannot broaden authority; indexes bind model/config/graph roots; tampering and split crossing fail closed; retrieval never returns a grant.

CVESIR-G060.title: Bounded lexical, vector, and graph retrieval

completion_evidence.acceptance_criterion: Leakage checks cover repo, commit, body hash, and near duplicates; metrics are stratified; fixed negatives cannot inherit vulnerable labels; thresholds are measured; failed gates cannot promote candidates.
Bounded shards and schemas validate; card documents source/license/limitations; release root is stable; validate-only requires no credentials; no secrets/caches/internal bodies enter staging.
Dry-run is default; target/source/release tuple is idempotent; credentials never persist; remote revision and shard/schema verification are mandatory before a receipt is proposed.

CVESIR-G090.title: Idempotent publish and remote verification command

completion_evidence.acceptance_criterion: Receipt binds authenticated principal, target repo, source revision, derived release root, Hub commit, remote manifest/shards/schema, timestamp, and verification result without containing credentials.

CVESIR-G095.title: Publish and pin the derived Hugging Face dataset

completion_evidence.acceptance_criterion: Terms are typed/versioned/canonical; unknown and wildcard-broadened terms fail closed; CWE is classification rather than sufficient policy authority; aliases cannot merge distinct scopes.
Mapping is loss-aware and round-trippable; source and review state are mandatory; candidates cannot claim authoritative result state; wildcard/generalized scopes require explicit review.

CVESIR-G110.title: CVE candidates to canonical Security IR adapter

completion_evidence.acceptance_criterion: Typed symbols bind exact scope; deny maps to prohibition; unsupported semantics emit diagnostics; formulas and obligations are non-authoritative; vulnerable/fixed controls demonstrate polarity.
Floating revisions, manifest drift, missing shards, row tampering, unknown schema, and candidate-as-authority fail closed; offline cache preserves revision identity.

CVESIR-G130.title: Pinned Hugging Face Security IR source adapter

completion_evidence.acceptance_criterion: Facts bind tree/blob/diff/AST identities; only changed scope is attributed; unsupported/ambiguous extraction is explicit; source strings cannot inject facts; extractors never grant authority.

CVESIR-G140.title: Generated-code security fact contract and extractors

completion_evidence.acceptance_criterion: Every request binds principal/action/tool/target/data_flow/effect/state/authority and Security IR root; intent pass cannot mask code fail; ambiguous mappings are unknown; exact matching follows existing adapter contracts.
Deny/conflict/unknown/stale reject; allow requires existing authority; generated undeclared effects reject; root or tree drift invalidates receipts; no permit or merge path bypasses the gate.
Receipts are canonical, bounded, redacted, stage/tree/root-bound, and distinguish evidence from authority; cache keys invalidate on every declared dependency.

CVESIR-G170.title: Bounded security decision receipts and observability

completion_evidence.acceptance_criterion: Hermetic fixture passes all cases; live-Hub smoke is opt-in; shadow/assist/enforce/rollback modes are documented; rollback pins prior Security IR root without weakening checks.

CVESIR-G180.title: End-to-end conformance, rollback, and operator rollout
